The '''Shadow Wing''', also known as the '''Dark Wing''', was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group that operated during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Activities==
The Shadow Wing carried out attacks on worlds along the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]. The group raided [[Human/Legends|Human]] worlds 15% more often than non-Human worlds and was always on the move. They would repair and use any combat ships that they found and scavenged other ships for parts. Only very rarely did they sell captured cargoes on the black market, as they instead used all captured items to support the Shadow Wing [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. The Shadow Wing usually left their victims alive, only killing those who resisted them.

==Composition==
The Shadow Wing was lead by the [[Tiss'shar/Legends|Tiss'shar]] [[Abin-Ral-Xufush]], a former trader. The group numbered about 2,000 pirates, including members of a number of smaller pirate gangs that had been absorbed into it. Its fleet consisted of a [[Bulk cruiser/Legends|bulk cruiser]]; three [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]], including the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Fa-Loh-Sui (corvette)|''Fa-Loh-Sui'']]; and 20 [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], including [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]], [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-Wings]] and [[Ugly/Legends|Uglies]].
